verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email product, but nothing in the evidence shows Gmail can be deployed on user-controlled infrastructure. Several items are related but do not count as self-hosting. IMAP/POP/SMTP access from third-party clients, offline mode and custom-domain business email are all ways of using Google's hosted service. Community mentions of self-hosted Dovecot describe users leaving Gmail, not a Gmail capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
